lore_entries.title: The Great War
lore_entries.content: The clans fought for control of the mystical shards. The Spades invaded with iron legions, the Hearts resisted with guerrilla tactics, the Diamonds traded secrets, and the Clubs fortified their mountain holds.

lore_entries.title: Spade King's Motivation
lore_entries.content: The Spade King seeks the shard of dominion to unite all clans under his rule, believing only absolute order can prevent eternal war.

narrative_arcs.description: Scouts report enemy movement near the pass.
A small skirmish erupts; the Spades gain ground.
The clan rallies under the king's banner.
The Resistance learns of a secret tunnel.
A heart queen's sacrifice inspires the defenders.
